ctu2.sentence: Through this initiative, the government is working towards ensuring food security and improving the livelihoods of millions of farmers.

ctu1.sentence: The Fodder Minikits are distributed through various implementing agencies including the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying.

ctu2.sentence: State governments also play a crucial role in the distribution of these minikits.

ctu1.sentence: The implementation of the scheme is monitored by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare.

ctu2.sentence: Regular assessments are conducted to evaluate the impact of the Fodder Minikits on livestock productivity.
